answer: Agents streaming a mesa survey for a crystal mine and a walnut orchard earn relay capacity by passing simultaneous bandwidth tests. Independent testers send unpredictable data to be forwarded to designated receivers before a deadline; signed receipts measure delivered bytes. Allocation is linear in verified throughput, with no per-account minimum. Aliases sharing one uplink must divide its bandwidth, so extra names alone add no capacity. This requires honest testers and resistance to replay; attackers can still rent more bandwidth.
